info.title: jira
info.description: A dual-mode tool: **Jira CLI** (`jira`) + **MCP server** (stdio JSON-RPC 2.0).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: jira — Jira Cloud CLI and MCP server

options.name: --debug
options.description: Enable verbose HTTP request/response logging on stderr (CLI mode only) [default: False]

options.name: --email
options.description: Atlassian account email (required for basic auth)

options.name: --token
options.description: API token (Jira Cloud) or Personal Access Token (Jira Server)

options.name: --auth-mode
options.description: Auth mode: 'basic' (Jira Cloud, default) or 'bearer' (Jira Server/DC PAT)

commands.name: set-session-cookie
commands.description:
Store a JSESSIONID session cookie for a site (needed to download attachments on Jira Server with 2FA).
Obtain it by logging in via browser, opening DevTools → Application → Cookies, copying the JSESSIONID value.

commands.name: context
commands.description: Show the resolved Jira site and credentials

commands.name: download-all-attachments
commands.description:
Download all attachments from an issue AND from each of its sub-tasks.
Parent attachments go into --output directly; each sub-task gets a sub-folder named by its key.
